name: Simplio3D Product Configurator
author: Digital Artflow

sections.description:
Simplio3D is a 3D product configurator and CPQ platform. This plugin brings your Simplio3D projects into WordPress as native blocks that you arrange like any other content, and connects them to WooCommerce.

Simplio3D stays responsible for your 3D models, materials, option logic, conditional rules, pricing and requests. WordPress controls the page layout, the styling and the store.

Blocks (Simplio3D v3)

Find them in the block inserter under Simplio3D:

  • Viewer — the interactive 3D view of a project.
  • Options — one option from your project (material, colour, size, text, upload, toggle…). Add one block per option and place them anywhere: next to the viewer, below it, in columns.
  • Price — the live configuration price.
  • Summary — the current configuration in plain words.
  • Submit / Add to Cart — send a quote request through Simplio3D, or add the configuration to the WooCommerce cart.

All blocks of a configurator share one live configuration: changing a material in an Options block instantly updates the 3D view, the price, the summary and what goes into the cart — without reloading the page. Several configurators can live on the same page.

Highlights

  • Connect your Simplio3D account securely: you sign in on app.simplio3d.ai and approve the site. No passwords or API keys are copied into WordPress.
  • Pick projects and options from visual lists — no IDs, tokens or JSON to paste.
  • Blocks added after the Viewer pick up its project automatically.
  • Supports Simplio3D conditional logic: options and choices show, hide and limit themselves automatically.
  • Secure WooCommerce pricing: the shopper’s browser never sets the price. When a configuration is added to the cart, your WordPress server asks Simplio3D to validate it and calculate the price.
  • Configuration details and a picture of the configuration appear in the cart, checkout, order emails and WooCommerce → Orders.
  • Quote requests go to your Simplio3D Requests with your usual email, PDF and webhook settings.
  • Responsive and touch friendly, with a separate mobile viewer height.
  • Starter layouts (block patterns), per-block scoped Custom CSS, and a [simplio3d] shortcode for page builders.
  • The 3D engine loads only on pages with a Viewer block, only when it scrolls into view.

Existing users: Legacy mode

Sites that used earlier versions of this plugin (the [simplio3d_configurator] shortcode and the app.simplio3d.com platform) stay in Legacy mode after updating — your pages, WooCommerce setup and orders keep working exactly as before. When you are ready, Simplio3D → Migration scans your site, shows everything that uses the legacy integration and lets you switch to Simplio3D v3. Switching never rewrites your content and can be undone.

External services

This plugin connects to the Simplio3D platform (https://app.simplio3d.ai), a service operated by Simplio3D, which is required for Simplio3D v3 blocks to work:

  • Account connection — when an administrator clicks “Connect Simplio3D”, the browser opens app.simplio3d.ai to sign in and approve the site. WordPress then exchanges a one-time code (server to server) for a site token that is stored encrypted in your database. Sent: your site URL, site name and the plugin version.
  • Editor data — while you edit pages, your WordPress server requests your project list, project summaries and default prices from the Simplio3D API using the site token.
  • Configurator display — visitors’ browsers load the published (shared) project data and 3D model files from Simplio3D servers. Sent: the project’s public share link and the page’s address (so owners can restrict which domains may embed a project).
  • Add to Cart — your WordPress server sends the chosen options to Simplio3D to validate the configuration and calculate the price. No customer personal data is sent.
  • Submit (quote requests) — the visitor’s browser sends the configuration and the form details the visitor enters (for example name and email address) to Simplio3D, where they are stored in the project owner’s Requests.

Simplio3D terms of use: https://www.simplio3d.com/terms-of-use — privacy policy: https://www.simplio3d.com/privacy-policy

In Legacy mode the [simplio3d_configurator] shortcode embeds a configurator from app.simplio3d.com (the Simplio3D v1 platform) in an iframe, and WooCommerce order updates are sent to the order link provided by that configurator.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “Simplio3D”).
  2. Go to Simplio3D in the WordPress admin menu and click Log in to Simplio3D (or Create a free account — new accounts include a 30-day trial). Approve the site on app.simplio3d.ai.
  3. Edit a page and add the Simplio3D Viewer block. Choose your project.
  4. Add a Simplio3D Options block for each option you want to show, then Price, Summary and Submit / Add to Cart blocks wherever you like. Or start from a pattern: Simplio3D → “New page: Viewer + sidebar”.
  5. For Add to Cart, choose the WooCommerce product the configurator sells as (a simple product). The product is linked to the project and priced by Simplio3D.
  6. Publish.

Your project must be published (Share) in Simplio3D, without a share password, and — if you use domain restrictions — allow your site’s domain.
sections.faq:
I used the plugin before. Will my configurator stop working?

No. Updated sites stay in Legacy mode and the [simplio3d_configurator] shortcode, the Add to Basket bridge and your order data keep working. Switching to Simplio3D v3 is optional (Simplio3D → Migration) and reversible.

Can a shopper change the price?

No. The price in the cart is calculated by Simplio3D on the server from a validated configuration. Unknown options, options hidden by conditional logic and out-of-range values are refused, and the WooCommerce product must be linked to the configurator’s project. The price the browser displays is for display only.

Which option types are supported?

Dropdown, Select Material (including materials from a category), Thumbnail Selector, Carousel, Checkbox, Toggle, Number Input, price variables, Text Input, File Upload and Pattern Designer (pattern choice). Text and uploaded images are included in quote requests and orders; drawing them onto the 3D model inside WordPress blocks is not available yet. The Design Canvas links to the full Simplio3D configurator.

Modular projects?

The Viewer block shows Modular projects as the full Simplio3D configurator (module placement happens inside it). Choose “Full Simplio3D configurator” display mode for any project to use the complete hosted experience.

Some projects can’t be added to the cart with the Simplio3D price. Why?

A few advanced pricing features (for example bespoke pricing blocks or numeric conditional rules that change which options are priced) cannot yet be verified on the server. For those projects the block editor warns you; use the WooCommerce product price or Submit mode instead.

Can I use it with Elementor or the classic editor?

Yes — every block shows its equivalent [simplio3d …] shortcode in its Advanced panel.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. Viewer, Options, Price, Summary and Submit (quote requests) work without WooCommerce. Add to Cart requires WooCommerce.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: Simplio3D v3 blocks — Viewer, Options, Price, Summary and Submit / Add to Cart — in a “Simplio3D” block category, sharing one live configuration per configurator.
  • New: secure account connection (browser sign-in + approval; no passwords or API keys in WordPress).
  • New: WooCommerce Add to Cart with server-side validation and pricing by Simplio3D; configuration details and image in cart, checkout, emails and orders; project ↔ product linking. A linked product sold at the Simplio3D price can only be added through its configurator — except when your Simplio3D dashboard’s WooCommerce connection also sells it, which keeps working unchanged.
  • New: quote requests through the Simplio3D request pipeline.
  • New: Simplio3D admin page (account, trial/subscription status), migration assistant, diagnostics, block patterns and the [simplio3d] shortcode.
  • Legacy mode: existing installations keep the v1 integration unchanged. Fixed: a [simplio3d_configurator] height given without a unit (including the default) now renders at the intended height; oversized data-URL thumbnails are ignored.

1.0.1

  • Fixed Plugin Check warnings and improved production readiness.
  • Improved WooCommerce add to cart request handling and validation.
  • Added order webhooks for external order creation and status updates.
  • Improved cart integration reliability for configurator-based products.

1.0

  • Initial release with shortcode support and WooCommerce cart integration.
